text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp said Monday it expects some improvement in profit margins in the second quarter, and further improvement in the third and fourth quarters.
The open-frame monitor maker said it received orders of $5.8 million in February.

"We are pleased with our second consecutive month of strong orders," said Chief Executive Tony Spier. "We have now received over $16 million in orders since the beginning of the year and we are particularly gratified that they came from all market segments. The February orders will be shipped primarily in the first and second quarters."
He said sales in the first quarter will be strong, but margins will continue to be adversely affected by product mix.

He said the company is taking steps to improve margins, including release of seven new products, and driving costs down on eight high-volume products. "In addition, some of the company's major vendors have agreed to some across-the-board cost reductions," he said.
